_comment: Runtime AI-provider registry, read by BOTH the bridge gateway and kagebox. To add any OpenAI-compatible AI API: add an entry here, put its key in bridge/secrets.env, restart the bridge (./kagebox bridge start), then `./kagebox backend <name>`. Keys stay on the HOST and are injected by the gateway; they never enter the sandbox. Fields: route_prefix (path on the bridge), upstream (real API base), auth_header/auth_scheme(bearer|raw)/auth_env (how the host key is injected), extra_headers (defaults, set only if the client didn't send them), bridge_path (what Hermes' base_url uses under the gateway), hermes_provider (Hermes provider name, usually 'custom'), model, context_length.
_budget_comment: Spend caps enforced by the bridge (#15). 0 = unlimited. The VM bounds CPU/memory/disk by construction, but the guest can still SPEND host-held keys, so requests/day and usd/day are capped per provider. price_per_mtok is USD per MILLION tokens and is what usd_per_day is measured in; update it when provider pricing changes. Add a top-level "defaults": {"budget": {...}} to change the fallback for every provider.
